requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL assemble runtime objects from RuntimeInstance src/create/prototype declarations using injected code-symbol resolution.

case.given: a RuntimeInstance declaration uses src, create, or prototype
case.then: the runtime object SHALL be created through injected symbol resolution

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL call runtime factories and derive functions with the DEPA shape output = fn(runtime, input, config).

case.given: a runtime factory or derive function is invoked
case.then: the call SHALL use the runtime-first DEPA argument order

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL bind Scope.runtime declarations to runtime objects and expose the resulting scope runtime map.

case.then: the resolved runtime objects SHALL be available through that Scope runtime map

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL report recoverable runtime assembly failures as HALFCODE_RUNTIME_* diagnostics.

case.given: runtime object assembly fails in a recoverable way
case.then: the result SHALL contain a HALFCODE_RUNTIME_* diagnostic
